title: Cá kho (caramelised fish, clay-pot style)
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Caramelise the sugar with 1 tbsp water in a small pot until light brown, add the shallots, garlic and ginger and sweat briefly.
Add the fish sauce and 100 ml water, lay in the fish pieces and simmer gently, covered, for 12–15 minutes until the sauce is syrupy.
Sauté the pak choi in the oil for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle the fish with pepper, chilli and spring onions and serve with rice and pak choi.
